I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats, not the number she posted in #north-team this morning.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything or post anywhere else. A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in #north-random, so repeating it there was fine.

One thing to know: I have no saved records, so "noted" just means I've got the correction for this conversation. Her original number is still in #north-team. If she wants it fixed there, she or someone on the team will need to post the correction in that channel.
